from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentKeyFeatures(BaseModel):
    """Extractable features of a single judgment document for matching against result options."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The identifier of the document, e.g., '《判决文书 1》'")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case, e.g., '民事', '刑事', '行政'")
    party_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of the appellants/petitioners involved in the case")
    ruling_conclusion: str | None = Field(description="The core disposition text, e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '撤销原裁定，发回重审'")
    court_fee_amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount of the court fees if specified, preserving units")
    fee_payer: str | None = Field(description="The party responsible for the court fees")
    procedural_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Specific procedural keywords extracted, e.g., '发回重审', '驳回再审申请'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentKeyFeatures]
